first_pass.summary: The CDC report states 800 confirmed measles cases were reported in the U.S. from January 1–April 17, 2025, but this is not a full-year count. Of these, 557 were laboratory-confirmed, while 251 were epidemiologically linked. Not all confirmed cases were laboratory-confirmed, as some were linked through contact tracing.
